reviews.body: Checked this against main: the new wire-body test fails without the change and passes with it, and `go test ./ai ./agent` is clean. Since OpenAI streams will now end with a usage-only chunk too, I went looking for anything that indexes `chunk.Choices[0]` without a length check. Both doc examples are guarded and nothing inside the SDK indexes stream chunks, so there's no new panic path. For later: Azure only documents `stream_options` from 2024-09-01-preview / 2024-10-21 GA and on the v1 route. Someone pushing an older dated api-version through a custom transport could get a 400, but the SDK itself doesn't build that path.
